examples.en: We should consider every aspect of the plan before we decide.
examples.zh: 我們決定之前，應該先考慮這個計畫的各個方面。

examples.en: Which aspect of the job do you enjoy the most?
examples.zh: 這份工作的哪個層面你最喜歡？

examples.en: The teacher explained one aspect of the problem at a time.
examples.zh: 老師一次說明問題的一個面向。

examples.en: She took an aspirin because she had a headache.
examples.zh: 她頭痛，所以吃了一顆阿斯匹靈。

examples.en: Aspirin can help lower a fever in some adults.
examples.zh: 阿斯匹靈可以幫助部分成人退燒。

examples.en: The pharmacist told him not to take aspirin on an empty stomach.
examples.zh: 藥師告訴他不要空腹吃阿斯匹靈。

examples.en: It took us an hour to assemble the new bookshelf.
examples.zh: 我們花了一個小時組裝新的書架。

examples.en: Students must assemble on the playground at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 學生必須在八點到操場集合。

examples.en: The manager assembled a team to finish the project.
examples.zh: 經理召集了一個團隊來完成這項專案。

examples.en: The principal spoke to the whole school at the morning assembly.
examples.zh: 校長在晨間集會時對全校師生講話。

examples.en: The assembly of this desk takes about twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 組裝這張書桌大約要二十分鐘。

examples.en: The national assembly passed the new law last week.
examples.zh: 國民議會上週通過了這項新法律。

examples.en: The teacher assigned a short essay for homework.
examples.zh: 老師指定了一篇短文當作業。

examples.en: The company assigned her to the sales department.
examples.zh: 公司把她派到業務部門。

examples.en: Each student was assigned a seat in the classroom.
examples.zh: 每位學生都被分配了教室裡的一個座位。

examples.en: Thank you for your assistance with the move.
examples.zh: 謝謝你協助我們搬家。

examples.en: Passengers who need assistance should ask the staff.
examples.zh: 需要協助的乘客請詢問工作人員。

examples.en: The school offers financial assistance to students in need.
examples.zh: 學校提供經濟援助給有需要的學生。

examples.en: Many people associate the color red with good luck.
examples.zh: 許多人會把紅色和好運聯想在一起。

examples.en: He does not want to be associated with the scandal.
examples.zh: 他不想和那件醜聞扯上關係。

examples.en: She likes to associate with people who love reading.
examples.zh: 她喜歡和愛閱讀的人往來。

examples.en: My business associate will meet us at the airport.
examples.zh: 我的生意夥伴會在機場和我們碰面。

examples.en: She is an associate of the law firm.
examples.zh: 她是這間律師事務所的受僱律師。

examples.en: He introduced me to an associate from his office.
examples.zh: 他向我介紹了他辦公室的一位同事。

examples.en: He joined the local teachers' association last year.
examples.zh: 他去年加入了當地的教師協會。

examples.en: The smell of bread has a strong association with my childhood.
examples.zh: 麵包的香味讓我強烈聯想到童年。

examples.en: There is a close association between sleep and health.
examples.zh: 睡眠與健康之間有密切的關聯。

examples.en: The manager gave us his assurance that the goods would arrive on time.
examples.zh: 經理向我們保證貨物會準時送達。

examples.en: She spoke with the assurance of an experienced teacher.
examples.zh: 她說話時帶著經驗豐富的老師那種自信。

examples.en: We need some assurance that the price will not go up.
examples.zh: 我們需要有人保證價格不會上漲。

examples.en: I assure you that the food is safe to eat.
examples.zh: 我向你保證這些食物可以安心食用。

examples.en: The doctor assured her that the operation was simple.
examples.zh: 醫生要她放心，這個手術很簡單。

examples.en: This lock will assure the safety of your bike.
examples.zh: 這個鎖可以確保你腳踏車的安全。

senses.zh: 運動的；體格健壯的；體育的

examples.en: He has an athletic build because he runs every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上跑步，所以體格健壯。

examples.en: The school holds an athletic meet every autumn.
examples.zh: 學校每年秋天都舉辦運動會。

examples.en: She bought a pair of athletic shoes for gym class.
examples.zh: 她買了一雙體育課穿的運動鞋。

examples.en: The atmosphere of Earth protects us from harmful rays.
examples.zh: 地球的大氣層保護我們不受有害射線的傷害。

examples.en: The cafe has a warm and friendly atmosphere.
examples.zh: 這間咖啡店的氣氛溫暖又親切。

examples.en: A quiet atmosphere helps students focus on their work.
examples.zh: 安靜的環境能幫助學生專心做功課。

examples.en: The air, water, and rocks around us are made of atoms.
examples.zh: 我們周遭的空氣、水和岩石都是由原子組成的。

examples.en: An atom is too small to be seen with the eye.
examples.zh: 原子小到肉眼看不見。

examples.en: The science teacher drew a model of an atom on the board.
examples.zh: 自然科老師在黑板上畫了一個原子的模型。

examples.en: The atomic number of hydrogen is one.
examples.zh: 氫的原子序是一。

examples.en: The class learned about atomic structure in science class.
examples.zh: 全班在自然課學了原子結構。

examples.en: Atomic energy can be used to make electricity.
examples.zh: 原子能可以用來發電。

examples.en: Please attach your photo to the application form.
examples.zh: 請把你的照片附在申請表上。

examples.en: I attached the file to my email.
examples.zh: 我把檔案附在電子郵件裡。

examples.en: She attached a name tag to her suitcase.
examples.zh: 她在行李箱上繫了一個名牌。

senses.zh: 吸引力；景點；吸引人的事物

examples.en: The Taipei 101 tower is a popular tourist attraction.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是熱門的觀光景點。

examples.en: The beautiful beach is the main attraction of the town.
examples.zh: 美麗的海灘是這座小鎮最大的吸引力。

examples.en: Many young people feel a strong attraction to new technology.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人對新科技有強烈的興趣。

examples.en: This video has an audio problem, so I cannot hear the speaker.
examples.zh: 這部影片的音訊有問題，我聽不到講者的聲音。

examples.en: Please check the audio equipment before the meeting starts.
examples.zh: 會議開始前請先檢查音響設備。

examples.en: You can download the audio file from our website.
examples.zh: 你可以從我們的網站下載音訊檔。

examples.en: The audio of the movie is clear and loud.
examples.zh: 這部電影的聲音又清楚又大聲。

examples.en: I turned off the audio and read the subtitles.
examples.zh: 我關掉聲音，看字幕。

examples.en: The audio is out of sync with the video.
examples.zh: 聲音和畫面不同步。

examples.en: Only the manager has the authority to approve the plan.
examples.zh: 只有經理有權核准這個計畫。

examples.en: Local authorities closed the road because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 地方當局因為大雨封閉了這條道路。

examples.en: She is an authority on ancient history.
examples.zh: 她是古代史的權威。

examples.en: He wrote an autobiography about his life as a farmer.
examples.zh: 他寫了一本關於他務農生活的自傳。

examples.en: The library has her autobiography on the second floor.
examples.zh: 圖書館二樓有她的自傳。

examples.en: We had to read an autobiography for English class.
examples.zh: 我們英文課必須讀一本自傳。

examples.en: Passengers should await further news in the waiting room.
examples.zh: 乘客請在候車室等候進一步的消息。

examples.en: We are awaiting the test results from the hospital.
examples.zh: 我們正在等候醫院的檢驗結果。

examples.en: A big surprise awaits you at home.
examples.zh: 家裡有一個大驚喜在等著你。

senses.zh: 禿頭的；光禿的；胎紋磨平的

examples.en: My uncle went bald when he was thirty.
examples.zh: 我叔叔三十歲就禿頭了。

examples.en: The baby is still almost bald, with only a few soft hairs.
examples.zh: 這個寶寶還幾乎沒有頭髮，只有幾根柔軟的毛髮。

examples.en: The bald tire was not safe to drive on.
examples.zh: 那條胎紋磨平的輪胎在行駛時並不安全。

examples.en: She has taken ballet lessons since she was five.
examples.zh: 她從五歲起就學芭蕾舞。

examples.en: We watched a ballet at the national theater last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚在國家劇院看了一齣芭蕾舞劇。

examples.en: Ballet shoes are soft and light, allowing dancers to move easily.
examples.zh: 芭蕾舞鞋又軟又輕，讓舞者能輕鬆移動。

examples.en: The nurse put a clean bandage on his arm.
examples.zh: 護理師在他的手臂上包了乾淨的繃帶。

examples.en: Keep a bandage in your bag in case of small cuts.
examples.zh: 包包裡放一捲繃帶，以防小傷口。

examples.en: She changed the bandage twice a day.
examples.zh: 她一天換兩次繃帶。

examples.en: The doctor bandaged my sprained ankle after checking it carefully.
examples.zh: 醫生仔細檢查我扭傷的腳踝後，用繃帶加以包紮。

examples.en: Please bandage the cut before you play.
examples.zh: 玩之前請先把傷口包紮好。

examples.en: He bandaged his knee after falling off his bike.
examples.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來後，把膝蓋包紮起來。

examples.en: The small shop went bankrupt after the new mall opened.
examples.zh: 那家小店在新的購物中心開幕後倒閉了。

examples.en: The bankrupt company could not pay its workers.
examples.zh: 破產的公司付不出員工的薪水。

examples.en: He was declared bankrupt last spring after his business failed.
examples.zh: 他的生意失敗後，於去年春天被宣告破產。

examples.en: Poor decisions nearly bankrupted the family business.
examples.zh: 錯誤的決定差點使這家家族企業破產。

examples.en: The high rent bankrupted many small restaurants.
examples.zh: 高昂的租金使許多小餐廳破產。

examples.en: Too much debt can bankrupt a person.
examples.zh: 負債過多會使人破產。

senses.zh: 特價品；划算的交易；協議

examples.en: This jacket was a real bargain at half price.
examples.zh: 這件夾克半價真的很划算。

examples.en: Shoppers lined up early to look for bargains.
examples.zh: 購物的人很早就排隊要找特價品。

examples.en: They made a bargain to share the cost of the trip.
examples.zh: 他們協議分攤這趟旅行的費用。

examples.en: Tourists often bargain with sellers at the night market.
examples.zh: 遊客常在夜市跟攤販討價還價。

examples.en: She bargained with the driver over the price.
examples.zh: 她和司機議價。

examples.en: It is not polite to bargain in a department store.
examples.zh: 在百貨公司討價還價不太禮貌。

examples.en: Language can be a barrier when you travel abroad.
examples.zh: 出國旅行時，語言可能是一種障礙。

examples.en: A low barrier stopped cars from entering the park.
examples.zh: 一道矮柵欄擋住了要進入公園的車輛。

examples.en: Shyness is a big barrier to making friends.
examples.zh: 害羞是交朋友的一大障礙。

examples.en: She filled the basin with warm water.
examples.zh: 她在臉盆裡裝滿溫水。

examples.en: The city sits in a basin surrounded by mountains.
examples.zh: 這座城市位在群山環繞的盆地中。

examples.en: Please wash your hands in the basin.
examples.zh: 請在洗手台洗手。

examples.en: The battery in my phone runs out quickly.
examples.zh: 我手機的電池很快就沒電。

examples.en: We need new batteries for the remote control.
examples.zh: 我們需要幫遙控器換新電池。

examples.en: This laptop battery lasts about ten hours.
examples.zh: 這台筆記型電腦的電池可以用大約十個小時。

examples.en: A beggar sat near the station asking for coins.
examples.zh: 一名乞丐坐在車站附近討零錢。

examples.en: The old beggar thanked us for the sandwich.
examples.zh: 那位年老的乞丐謝謝我們給他三明治。

examples.en: In the story, a kind man shares his food with a beggar.
examples.zh: 故事中，一位好心人和乞丐分享他的食物。

examples.en: The teacher praised the children for their good behavior.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚孩子們行為良好。

examples.en: Rude behavior is not allowed in our classroom.
examples.zh: 我們教室裡不允許粗魯的行為。

examples.en: The scientist studies the behavior of birds.
examples.zh: 這位科學家研究鳥類的行為。

examples.en: Please throw the paper into the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 請把紙丟進資源回收桶。

examples.en: The bin by the door is full of old newspapers.
examples.zh: 門邊的箱子裡裝滿了舊報紙。

examples.en: He keeps his toys in a plastic bin under the bed.
examples.zh: 他把玩具放在床下的塑膠箱裡。

examples.en: I borrowed a biography of Albert Einstein from the library.
examples.zh: 我從圖書館借了一本愛因斯坦的傳記。

examples.en: The biography tells the story of her childhood in Tainan.
examples.zh: 這本傳記描述了她在台南的童年。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to write a short biography of a famous person.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇名人的簡短傳記。

examples.en: Blend the milk and the eggs in a large bowl.
examples.zh: 把牛奶和蛋在大碗裡混合。

examples.en: The colors blend well with each other.
examples.zh: 這些顏色彼此很搭。

examples.en: The old building blends in with the quiet street.
examples.zh: 這棟老建築與安靜的街道很協調。

examples.en: This tea is a blend of green tea and flowers.
examples.zh: 這種茶是綠茶和花的混合。

examples.en: The song is a blend of rock and traditional music.
examples.zh: 這首歌融合了搖滾與傳統音樂。

examples.en: The soup has a nice blend of spices.
examples.zh: 這道湯的香料調配得很好。

examples.en: The old man gave the young couple his blessing.
examples.zh: 老先生給了這對年輕夫妻他的祝福。

examples.en: Good health is a great blessing that we should never take for granted.
examples.zh: 健康是一大福氣，我們絕不應視為理所當然。

examples.en: The rain was a blessing for the farmers.
examples.zh: 這場雨對農夫來說是件好事。

examples.en: She blinked when the bright light hit her eyes.
examples.zh: 強光照到她的眼睛時，她眨了眨眼。

examples.en: Try not to blink while I take the photo.
examples.zh: 我拍照時，盡量不要眨眼。

examples.en: The red light blinked on the dashboard.
examples.zh: 儀表板上的紅燈在閃爍。

examples.en: The blink of an eye is very short.
examples.zh: 眨眼的時間非常短。

examples.en: Summer vacation was over in a blink.
examples.zh: 暑假一眨眼就結束了。

examples.en: The goalkeeper stopped the ball in the blink of an eye.
examples.zh: 守門員一眨眼就擋住了球。

examples.en: Cherry trees bloom in early spring, attracting visitors to the park.
examples.zh: 櫻花樹在初春開花，吸引遊客前來公園。

examples.en: The roses in our garden bloom every June.
examples.zh: 我們花園裡的玫瑰在六月盛開。

examples.en: Her confidence began to bloom after she joined the choir.
examples.zh: 她加入合唱團後，自信開始綻放。

examples.en: The tulips are in full bloom this week.
examples.zh: 鬱金香這個禮拜正盛開。

examples.en: She put a single bloom in a glass vase.
examples.zh: 她把一朵花插進玻璃花瓶。

examples.en: The garden is beautiful when the blooms open.
examples.zh: 花朵盛開的時候，花園很美。

examples.en: Apple blossoms smell sweet in the spring.
examples.zh: 蘋果花在春天聞起來很香甜。

examples.en: Tourists come to see the cherry blossoms every year.
examples.zh: 每年都有遊客前來賞櫻花。

examples.en: The peach tree is in full blossom.
examples.zh: 桃樹正值盛開期。

examples.en: Plum trees blossom in the cold of winter.
examples.zh: 梅樹在寒冬中開花。

examples.en: The shy boy blossomed into a confident speaker.
examples.zh: 那個害羞的男孩成長為一位有自信的演講者。

examples.en: Their friendship blossomed over the summer as they worked together.
examples.zh: 他們在夏天一起工作，友誼也逐漸深厚。

examples.en: He likes to boast about his high test scores.
examples.zh: 他喜歡吹噓自己的高分成績。

examples.en: Don't boast about your new phone in front of everyone.
examples.zh: 不要在大家面前炫耀你的新手機。

examples.en: The city boasts a beautiful lake and a famous temple.
examples.zh: 這座城市擁有美麗的湖泊和一座著名的廟宇。

senses.zh: 自誇的話；引以為傲的事

examples.en: His boast about winning every game was not true.
examples.zh: 他吹噓自己每場比賽都贏，但那並非事實。

examples.en: It is her proud boast that she never missed a class.
examples.zh: 她引以為傲的是從來沒缺過課。

examples.en: Nobody believed the boast of the new player.
examples.zh: 沒有人相信那位新球員的大話。

examples.en: There is a strong bond between the two sisters.
examples.zh: 這兩姊妹之間有深厚的情誼。

examples.en: Shared meals create a bond between family members.
examples.zh: 一起吃飯能增進家人之間的感情。

examples.en: She bought a government bond as a safe investment.
examples.zh: 她買了政府公債作為安全的投資。

examples.en: The team bonded during the camping trip.
examples.zh: 這個團隊在露營旅行中建立了感情。

examples.en: Babies bond with their parents in the first months.
examples.zh: 寶寶在最初幾個月會與父母建立依附關係。

examples.en: This glue bonds wood to metal without leaving visible marks.
examples.zh: 這種膠水能把木頭黏在金屬上，而不留下明顯痕跡。

examples.en: The ball bounced down the stairs and landed near the door.
examples.zh: 球沿著樓梯彈下去，落在門邊。

examples.en: Children love to bounce on the soft bed.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在柔軟的床上彈跳。

examples.en: The email bounced back because the address was wrong.
examples.zh: 這封電子郵件因為地址錯誤而被退回。

examples.en: The ball has a high bounce on the hard gym floor.
examples.zh: 這顆球在堅硬的體育館地板上會彈得很高。

examples.en: With one bounce, the ball rolled into the net.
examples.zh: 球彈了一下就滾進了網子。

examples.en: The new shoes give each step a nice bounce.
examples.zh: 這雙新鞋讓每一步都很有彈性。

examples.en: She wears a silver bracelet on her left wrist.
examples.zh: 她的左手腕戴著一條銀手鍊。

examples.en: My grandmother gave me a jade bracelet for my birthday.
examples.zh: 奶奶送我一只玉鐲當生日禮物。

examples.en: The bracelet fell off while she was running.
examples.zh: 她跑步時手鍊掉了。

examples.en: A poodle is a popular breed of dog.
examples.zh: 貴賓狗是一種受歡迎的狗品種。

examples.en: This breed of cow gives a lot of milk.
examples.zh: 這個品種的乳牛產很多奶。

examples.en: What breed is your cat with the long white fur?
examples.zh: 你那隻長著白色長毛的貓是什麼品種？

examples.en: Farmers breed horses on the large ranch.
examples.zh: 農夫們在大牧場上繁殖馬匹。

examples.en: Many birds breed in the north during summer.
examples.zh: 許多鳥在夏天於北方繁殖。

examples.en: The scientist tried to breed a sweeter kind of corn.
examples.zh: 這位科學家試著培育更甜的玉米品種。

examples.en: The bridegroom waited at the front of the church.
examples.zh: 新郎在教堂前方等候。

examples.en: The bride and the bridegroom cut the cake together.
examples.zh: 新娘和新郎一起切蛋糕。

examples.en: Everyone clapped when the bridegroom arrived at the wedding reception.
examples.zh: 新郎抵達婚宴現場時，大家都鼓掌。

examples.en: I can't go shopping because I'm broke this month.
examples.zh: 我這個月沒錢，沒辦法去逛街。

examples.en: He was broke after paying the rent.
examples.zh: 他付完房租後就沒錢了。

examples.en: The students were too broke to eat at a nice restaurant.
examples.zh: 學生們窮到沒錢去好一點的餐廳吃飯。

examples.en: She swept the kitchen floor with a broom.
examples.zh: 她用掃把掃廚房的地板。

examples.en: The broom is behind the door, next to the dustpan.
examples.zh: 掃把在門後面，就在畚箕旁邊。

examples.en: The children made a toy horse from an old broom.
examples.zh: 孩子們用舊掃把做了一匹玩具馬。

senses.zh: 殘酷的；嚴酷的；毫不留情的

examples.en: The brutal heat made it hard to play outside.
examples.zh: 酷熱的天氣讓人很難到戶外玩耍。

examples.en: It was a brutal winter with a lot of snow.
examples.zh: 那是一個下了很多雪的嚴冬。

examples.en: His brutal honesty about her performance hurt her feelings.
examples.zh: 他對她表現毫不留情的坦白傷了她的心。

examples.en: The school posted a bulletin about the field trip.
examples.zh: 學校貼出了校外教學的公告。

examples.en: Please read the bulletin board near the office.
examples.zh: 請看辦公室附近的佈告欄。

examples.en: The radio station gave a weather bulletin every hour.
examples.zh: 廣播電台每小時播報一次天氣簡報。

examples.en: The burglar broke a window and entered the house.
examples.zh: 竊賊打破窗戶進入了房子。

examples.en: A burglar alarm rang in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 防盜警報在半夜響了起來。

examples.en: The police caught the burglar a week later.
examples.zh: 一週後警方抓到了那個竊賊。

examples.en: Please calculate the total price of these three items.
examples.zh: 請計算這三樣東西的總價。

examples.en: We calculated the cost of the trip before booking.
examples.zh: 我們在訂位前先估算了旅費。

examples.en: Students can use a calculator to calculate the answer.
examples.zh: 學生可以用計算機算出答案。

examples.en: The school started a campaign to save water.
examples.zh: 學校發起了一項節約用水的活動。

examples.en: The company launched an advertising campaign for its new snack.
examples.zh: 公司為新推出的點心展開了廣告宣傳活動。

examples.en: She ran a campaign to become class president.
examples.zh: 她為了當班長而展開競選。

examples.en: Students campaigned for cleaner parks in the city.
examples.zh: 學生們為了讓城市的公園更乾淨而發起運動。

examples.en: She campaigned hard for a seat on the school council.
examples.zh: 她為了取得學生會席次而努力競選。

examples.en: Many people campaign against the use of plastic bags.
examples.zh: 許多人發起運動反對使用塑膠袋。
